content.title: Germany's Norma sells water management business to US company for $1 billion
content.summary: MUNICH (Reuters) -German automotive and industrial supplier Norma will sell its water management business to U.S. rival Advanced Drainage Systems in a deal valued at $1 billion, the companies said on Tuesday.  As a result of the deal, Norma is set to lose roughly a quarter of its forecast revenue this year as it works towards becoming a more focused industrial supplier.  Its shares were down 10.7% as of 1439 GMT after having opened 4% higher, though Norma's largest shareholder welcomed the move.
